meta_description:
186 likes, 2 comments - namratasoni on October 14, 2026: "For me, highlighter has never been about chunky glitter. It’s about that beautiful, lit-from-within glow. ✨

That was the thought behind creating Cosmic Glow by Simply NAM. I wanted a highlighter that wouldn’t sit on top of your skin, but would melt into it, blend seamlessly, and look like the glow was coming from within. 🤍

The secret? Less is more. ✨ Warm a little product between your fingertips and gently tap it onto your high cheekbones, the bridge of your nose, your brow bone, or anywhere you want that beautiful, natural luminosity. You can also use a fan brush for a soft, diffused finish.

Skip the thick, dense brush if you want that seamless, skin-like radiance. Your fingertips are often all you need to create the most stunning glow.

Because to me, the most beautiful highlight is the one that doesn’t scream highlighter , it simply makes your skin look luminous, healthy, and effortlessly radiant. Like you’re glowing from within. ✨

That’s Cosmic Glow. That’s the glow I believe in. 🤍
@simplynam.beauty 
#SimplyNAM #CosmicGlow #GlowFromWithin #SkinLikeGlow HighlighterLove MakeupByNamratasoni".
